column1: Open Questions for Milos - Simple Mode / Streamlined Work Order Completion & Receiving (Epic SV-7301)

column3: Which roles or org types have 'Require Review Before Completion' turned ON by default? Should brand-new orgs default it ON or OFF, and do existing orgs keep today's behaviour via a backfill?
column4: Determines the default review behaviour for new and existing shops, and sets the expected default state for the settings and review test cases. The spec flags the require-review default as unresolved.
column5: (a) OFF for all by default; (b) ON for bigger/existing shops, OFF for new orgs; (c) some other cohort rule.
column7: They should all have ON the review option

column3: When a work order is completed via the simple / skip path, should in-stock inventory parts auto-receive and decrement inventory (writing Part History), or not? What is the intended behaviour?
column4: The skip path's bare status setter can emit no events and bypass inventory movement / Part History / catalog creation. Whether inventory should still decrement is a data-integrity invariant.
column5: (a) Auto-decrement inventory + write Part History on completion; (b) no inventory movement on the skip path; (c) route the completion through the real receive lifecycle.
column7: We will not have No PO Bilal Muzamil, for some reason i cant remove this from COnfluence , but on the JIra is removed

column3: The spec says the first-use defaults are Auto-approve OFF and Vendor Invoice REQUIRED, but the design mockups show Auto-approve ON and Vendor Invoice Optional (and omit the Require-Review toggle). Which is authoritative for first-use defaults?
column4: The correct defaults must be confirmed before we can pass/fail the settings-default case and frame the completion-flow matrix. The live org baseline currently shows Auto-approve ON and Vendor Invoice Optional.
column5: (a) Spec defaults (Auto-approve OFF / invoice REQUIRED); (b) Design defaults (Auto-approve ON / invoice Optional); (c) other.
column7: (a) Spec defaults: Auto-approve OFF, Vendor Invoice REQUIRED (Story 1 + §4, "preserve today's behavior"). The mockup is showing the case which we think most users need and will use , IN case i need to create additional mock up for this Bilal Muzamil let me know

column3: The product spec is labelled V2.3 but both design handoffs cite 'Simple Mode V1.4'. Which version governs where the two differ?
column4: Design-vs-spec differences (defaults, tech-story placement, review states) cannot be adjudicated until the authoritative version is confirmed.
column5: (a) Spec V2.3 governs; (b) Design V1.4 governs; (c) case-by-case.
column7: Spec V2.3 governs behavior; design is a visual reference only.

column3: Spec S1-R2 requires a 'Create purchase orders' toggle (default ON) so POs can be switched OFF, but it does not exist in the current build and POs appear always-on (no createPurchaseOrders field in the settings API). Is this intended (descoped) or a bug?
column4: Without the toggle the 'No-PO / skip' configuration and its QuickBooks-integrity cases cannot be set up as specified.
column5: (a) Intended descope - POs are always on; (b) Bug - the toggle should be added.
column7: Due the chagnes where we removed the PO OFF , we changed the spec to address those , So we will Always have a PO

column3: The Save Settings button is clickable even when there are no unsaved changes (no dirty-state gating). Is this intended or a bug?
column4: Minor UX deviation from the expected 'disabled until a change is made' behaviour.
column5: (a) Intended; (b) Bug - Save should be disabled until something changes.
column7: Not spec'd. Low-priority polish — call it (a) intended for v1 or a nice-to-have (b); not a blocker either way.

column3: Story 16 (R7/R10) specifies an optional review-note field (input_review_note) in the Mark Reviewed dialog, but the live dialog shows only the VIN field. Is the note field intended or a bug?
column4: The optional-note case cannot pass as specified until this is confirmed.
column5: (a) Descoped - no note field; (b) Bug - the note field should be added.
column7: This is bug - (b) Bug — Story 16 R7 + R10 (input_review_note) specify the optional note will not be in the build. Review should step should show the same things as now ( with a little better design)

column3: Story 16 (R5/R8) describes Review -> Reviewed (green, 'sign-off complete') -> a separate final Complete Work Order -> Complete. Live, Confirm Review went straight to Complete with no distinct 'Reviewed' holding state. Is this intended or a bug?
column4: Determines whether a distinct Reviewed state plus a separate final Complete step are expected (this may be admin auto-progression). Affects the review state-machine cases and the invoicing-blocked-until-reviewed check.
column5: (a) Intended (single-step, e.g. for admins); (b) Bug - a distinct Reviewed state is expected before final Complete.

column3: The S15-R4 close-vs-cancel confirmation modal is marked 'Figma still to be added'. What is the intended behaviour, and when will the design ship?
column4: The close-confirm case's expected behaviour cannot be finalised until the design exists.
column7:
Behavior is defined (S15-R4) — QA can test the functional cases now:
▎ - Close (prominent/red button) → closes the confirmation modal only, no discard, stays on the work order.
▎ - Cancel (text link, far left) → closes the modal and returns to the previous screen.
▎ - Other consumers of the shared confirmation keep their existing action labels.

column3: S12-R1 says the vendor-missing group sits at the BOTTOM of the Accept Delivery screen; S12-R3 says the vendor-missing group LEADS (top). The spec contradicts itself - which is correct?
column4: Determines the expected ordering of the vendor-missing group on the Accept Delivery and Bulk Receive screens.
column5: (a) Vendor-missing group at the bottom; (b) Vendor-missing group leads (top).
column7: Spec contradicts itself (S12-R1 bottom vs S12-R3 top) — can't derive. Just pick one. Recommend (b) top/leads — it needs action (assign vendor) before receiving. I will do changes on the spec
